alternatives.option: Centralise TwiningError mapping for every command
alternatives.reason_rejected: changes nine tools' error codes on the 2.x line without a field-facing reason

context: CLI lane delivered on feat/cli-2.17 (worktree): shared command core (src/core/*, 39 commands moved verbatim, MCP adapter loop), createTwiningContext extracted from createServer, `twining` bin with JSON envelope/exit codes/capabilities/STORE_UNWRITABLE, docs/CLI.md, CHANGELOG unreleased 2.17.0; 123 git-dependent tests pass with working git; tsc clean.
rationale: Behavior-neutrality is the CLI lane's contract with the field: a centralised wrapper would have changed e.g. FORMAT_VERSION_TOO_NEW surfacing as INTERNAL_ERROR on those tools, which field automation may key on. Making the asymmetry explicit and named lets the v3 lane fix it deliberately later with a recorded decision.
summary: Accepted the lane's per-command `errors: "internal-only"` flag to preserve the nine handlers whose catch blocks never mapped TwiningError (twining_why, twining_triage, read/query/recent, three housekeeping tools, all coordination tools) rather than centralising error mapping and silently widening their error codes
